use_capture_fixture: use the capture fixture to capture and compare stdout and stderr in pytest tests
compare_with_output_class: compare test output with the Output class that ignores constructor and destructor lines
compare_with_unordered_class: compare test output with the Unordered class for output without strict line ordering
sanitize_docstrings_with_doc_fixture: sanitize pybind11 docstrings using the doc fixture for comparison in pytest tests
sanitize_messages_with_msg_fixture: sanitize exception messages using the msg fixture to normalize hexadecimal values in pytest tests
